column1: # Notes (revised after routing, commit on r12-relayout-W3). (1) Sensor bus to W4 at y 45.4, all on F, 0.1 mm, 0.4 mm pitch:
# IMU_CS 21.8, I2C1_SDA 22.6, I2C1_SCL 23.0, SPI1_MISO 23.4, HG_CS 23.8, SPI1_SCK 24.2, SPI1_MOSI 24.6, IMU_INT1 25.0. No B lane
# crosses the LI band: a B track over the critical NRST In2 lane removes its B GND reference (check_r12 K-reference). SCK and MOSI
# are adjacent and in U4's pin order; MISO / HG_CS / I2C sit between IMU_CS and SCK (ring 1 fixes A4 < A5 < A6 < A7); W4 takes the
# I2C pair, MISO and HG_CS to B aft of the LI band (vias at y <= 45.0) as ROUTING_PLAN section 2 intended; INT1 is east of MOSI for
# U4.4 on U4's east side. (2) Widths changed from the plan table: CA lanes 0.15 (a 0.2 lane cannot pass a via at 0.4 mm and keep the
# 0.2 mm via-hole clearance; route_check fails a width change at a free node), LED_RED 0.1 (passes vias at 0.4 mm).
# (3) Tight quadrant: fallback (b) in a no-via form: QSPI_CLK stays on F (channel y 54.8 between rows F and G), so the VCAP B paths
# cross under it with no CLK via; QSPI_IO0 enters U3.5 from its inner end, CLK U3.6 from its inner end, IO3 uses the 0.7 mm gap
# between C19 and U3's west pads; IO1 / IO2 reach U3's east pins through vias under U3's body. C19 / C20 do not move.
# (4) CX AUX lanes at x 41.0 (TX) / 41.4 (RX) inside strip CX; their forward vias sit west of x 38.8 (W3 polygon) at (35.0, 86.6) /
# (36.0, 87.3), so the B runs west along y 86.6 / 87.0 cross x 38.8 - 40.2 (W5's B area) between the strip and the W3 polygon.
